title: Hosted Teller crossing and pre-render credential lifecycle hardening
findings: The TINT061 pre-render entrypoint accepted a pre-existing shape-valid window session without a new one-time Tower handoff.
That early return could mount React without performing the required v2 exchange.
A denied v2 exchange could leave a previously injected window session reachable by other Teller code.
changes: Discard previous live Tower window session before processing every startup.
Require a fresh tower_handoff before production React mount; never authorize based on browser-memory shape alone.
Fail closed when an existing memory session cannot be cleared.
Keep DEV UI-only path while removing any prior persistence credential.
Add executable adversarial regression cases for stale, denied, wrong-version, fresh and uncleareable-session paths.
next_gates: Run checks and production build in CI
Review exact Tower v2 response and issuer proof
Prove hosted Tower-to-Teller-to-API crossing before static activation
